subject: Zenith Health: SOC 2 evidence — onboarding / separation training & background checks
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@zenithhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: security@zenithhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: onboarding / separation evidence for SOC 2 review

Irene —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SOC 2 readiness review we need a compact evidence bundle demonstrating how you handle new hires and leavers (focus: security training, background checks, and access removal timelines). Specifically we are looking for:

- current onboarding playbook or runbook that lists actions and timelines for access provisioning and training,
- a training completion matrix for the last 12 months (by role, with completion dates),
- a summary of background check coverage (what checks are run, who is in scope) plus a redacted export of the check outcomes for a 20-person sample,
- deprovisioning checklist and an example offboarding ticket showing when access was removed.

Can you provide a consolidated packet by EOD Monday (Nov 22)? If any of the items are sensitive we are fine with redacted exports — please note the redaction approach. If there's a faster way (shared drive link) that's fine.

Background: Zenith is conducting a narrow control review focused on personnel/identity controls for a pilot integration. We don't need PII in the sample, just proof of process and timestamps.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Security Assurance Manager | Zenith Health

P.S. happy to hop on a 20 min call Monday morning if helpful.

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding / separation evidence for SOC 2 review

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a consolidated packet by Monday EOD with redactions applied to personal identifiers. Plan and contents below:

1) Redwood Onboarding & Offboarding Playbook (PDF) — step-by-step runbook covering provisioning (IAM groups, MFA, Okta app assignments), required training gates, and vendor checks.
2) Training completion matrix (.csv) — role rows / person columns removed (we will provide role-level aggregates plus per-employee completion dates for the 20-person sample with names redacted).
3) Background check summary + redacted sample (.csv) — vendor, checks run, date of verification, final status (PASS/REVIEW). We will strip SSNs/DOBs and provide hashed identifiers.
4) Example offboarding ticket (screenshot/PDF) showing exact timestamps for access removal and account disablement.

Attachments we will include: redwood_onboarding_playbook_v2.pdf; training-completion-matrix_Q3-2026.csv; background-check-summary_redacted.csv.

A couple of notes: we perform background checks for all employees with access to production systems; contractor coverage varies by engagement and is enumerated in the playbook. Hashing approach: SHA256 of employee email for sample rows to preserve referential integrity for your reviewers without returning PII.

If Zenith prefers a shared Drive folder, I can upload and share a view-only folder — otherwise I'll reply-all with the attachments Monday morning and follow up with the Drive link. If you want the 20-person sample filtered to specific roles, let me know ASAP.

Irene Choi
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
(415) 555-0147

Attachment stubs: [redwood_onboarding_playbook_v2.pdf] [training-completion-matrix_Q3-2026.csv] [background-check-summary_redacted.csv]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding / separation evidence for SOC 2 review

Irene — quick operational questions before we finalize the CSVs:

- For the background-check sample, do we want to include vendor case IDs (they're internal to GoodScreen) or only vendor name + date + hashed id? I recommend omitting vendor case IDs to avoid cross-system references.
- Training matrix: we should include completion timestamps in UTC (ISO8601) and a role-level column (e.g., Platform Eng, SRE, Sales) — confirm the role taxonomy is fine for Zenith.
- Offboarding example: I can pull the outgoing ticket from our access management queue (ticket SUP-3309). Marissa — can you confirm the ticket screenshot shows the account disable step and the IAM group removal? If there are any legal redaction rules please flag.

If no objections I'll proceed with the redactions and coordinate upload to the shared Drive link in the thread.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Trust & Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@zenithhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: security@zenithhealth.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding / separation evidence for SOC 2 review

Irene / Karthik —

This is perfect, thanks. Vendor case IDs omitted is fine. Role taxonomy is acceptable — Platform Eng / SRE / Sales is exactly what we need. For the sample, hashed identifiers work. Please upload to a Drive folder and share view-only access to security@zenithhealth.com and me.

If there's anything we cannot accept redacted (unlikely), we'll flag it quickly. Otherwise this should cover the narrow review.

Thanks again — I'll expect the Drive link Monday.

Elena
Security Assurance Manager | Zenith Health
